Uzbekistan
Consular help: Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Moscow, Russia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Roma
Regular biometric passport NO for stays up to 30 days
Service/Official biometric passport NO for stays up to 30 days
Diplomatic biometric passport NO for stays up to 30 days
Citizens of the Republic of Uzbekistan are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Moscow, Russia.
Travel Tip: To enter the territory of the Republic of Uzbekistan, a passport must be valid for at least six months from the date of intended departure from the country.
The passport must have at least one blank page for entry/exit stamps.
